verses.geez: ወተንሥአ፡ ኤልያስ፡ ነቢይ፡ ዘከመ፡ እሳት፡ ወቃሉኒ፡ ከመ፡ ነድ፡ ያውዒ።
verses.translation: Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.

translations.lxx: Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.
translations.ron: Şi s-a sculat proorocul Ilie ca focul şi cuvântul lui ca făclia ardea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστη Ἠλίας προφήτης ὡς πῦρ, καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ ὡς λαμπὰς ἐκαίετο·

verses.geez: ወአምጽአ፡ ረኃብ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወበቅንአቱ፡ አውኀዶሙ።
verses.translation: He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.

translations.lxx: He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.
translations.ron: El a adus peste ei foamete şi cu râvna sa i-a împuţinat.
translations.grk: ὃς ἐπήγαγεν ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς λιμὸν, καὶ τῷ ζήλῳ αὐτοῦ ὠλιγοποίησεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወበቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከልኦ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ወአውረደ፡ እሳተ፡ እምሰማይ፡ ሥልሰ።
verses.translation: By the word of the Lord he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire.

translations.lxx: By the word of the Lord he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire.
translations.ron: Cu cuvântul Domnului a oprit cerul şi de trei ori a pogorât foc.
translations.grk: Ἐν λόγῳ Κυρίου ἀνέσχεν οὐρανὸν, κατήγαγεν οὕτως τρὶς πῦρ.

verses.geez: እፎ፡ ተሰባሕከ፡ ኤልያስ፡ በስብሐቲከ፡ ወመኑ፡ ተመክሐ፡ ከማከ።
verses.translation: O Elias, how wast thou honoured in thy wondrous deeds! and who may glory like unto thee!

translations.lxx: O Elias, how wast thou honoured in thy wondrous deeds! and who may glory like unto thee!
translations.ron: Cât te-ai mărit, Ilie, întru minunile tale! Şi cine este asemenea ţie, ca să se laude?
translations.grk: Ὡς ἐδοξάσθης Ἠλία ἐν τοῖς θαυμασίοις σου; καὶ τίς ὅμοιός σοι καυχᾶσθαι;

verses.geez: ዘአንሥአ፡ በድነ፡ እምነ፡ ምውታን፡ ወእምነ፡ መቃብርኒ፡ በቃለ፡ ልዑል።
verses.translation: Who didst raise up a dead man from death, and his soul from the place of the dead, by the word of the most High:

translations.lxx: Who didst raise up a dead man from death, and his soul from the place of the dead, by the word of the most High:
translations.ron: Cel care ai înviat pe mort din morţi şi din locaşul morţilor cu cuvântul Celui Preaînalt.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἐγείρας νεκρὸν ἐκ θυνάτου καὶ ἐξ ᾅδου ἐν λόγῳ ὑψίστου·

verses.geez: ወአውረዶሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ ወለክቡራን፡ እመነ፡ ዓራታቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: who broughtest kings to destruction, and honourable men from their bed:

translations.lxx: who broughtest kings to destruction, and honourable men from their bed:
translations.ron: Cel care ai răsturnat regi în pierzare şi pe cei măreţi de pe scaunul lor.
translations.grk: ὁ καταγαγὼν βασιλεῖς εἰς ἀπώλειαν, καὶ δεδοξασμένους ἀπὸ κλίνης αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ዘያ[ፀምእ፡]ኵነኔ፡ በሲና፡ ወበኮሬብ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወበቀለ።
verses.translation: who heardest the rebuke of the Lord in Sinai, and in Horeb the judgment of vengeance:

translations.lxx: who heardest the rebuke of the Lord in Sinai, and in Horeb the judgment of vengeance:
translations.ron: Cel care ai auzit în Sinai mustrare şi în Horeb judecăţile răzbunării.
translations.grk: ὁ ἀκούων ἐν Σινᾷ ἐλεγμὸν, καὶ ἐν Χωρὴβ κρίματα ἐκδικήσεως·

verses.geez: ዘይቀብኦሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወይትፈድዮሙ፡ ወተዐለዉ፡ ነቢያት፡ እምኔሁ።
verses.translation: who anointedst kings to take revenge, and prophets to succeed after him:

translations.lxx: who anointedst kings to take revenge, and prophets to succeed after him:
translations.ron: Cel care ai uns regi spre răsplătire şi prooroci următori după tine.
translations.grk: ὁ χρίων βασιλεῖς εἰς ἀνταπόδομα, καὶ προφήτας διαδόχους μετʼ αὐτόν·

verses.geez: ዘዐርገ፡ በነደ፡ እሳት፡ በሰረገላት፡ ወበአፍራስ፡ ዘእሳት።
verses.translation: who wast taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses:

translations.lxx: who wast taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses:
translations.ron: Cel care te-ai înălţat prin vifor de foc şi cu car de cai de flacără.
translations.grk: ὁ ἀναληφθεὶς ἐν λαίλαπι πυρὸς ἐν ἅρματι ἵππων πυρίνων·

verses.geez: ዘአጽሐፈ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ለዕድሜሁ፡ ከመ፡ ያቊርር፡ መዐተ፡ እምቅድመ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ወከመ፡ ያግብእ፡ ልበ፡ አብ፡ ኀበ፡ ውሉድ፡ ወከመ፡ ያቅሞሙ፡ ለአሕዛበ፡ ያዕቆብ።
verses.translation: who wast ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the Lord's judgment, before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father unto the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.

translations.lxx: who wast ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the Lord's judgment, before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father unto the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
translations.ron: Cel care eşti, precum este scris, hotărât pentru vremuri viitoare, ca să potoleşti mânia mai înainte de mânie, să întorci inima tatălui către fiu şi să aşezi seminţiile lui Iacov.
translations.grk: ὁ καταγραφεὶς ἐν ἐλεγμοῖς εἰς καιροὺς, κοπάσαι ὀργὴν πρὸ θυμοῦ, καὶ ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίαν πατρὸς πρὸς υἱὸν, καὶ καταστῆσαι φυλὰς Ἰακώβ.

verses.geez: ብፁዓን፡ እለ፡ ያአምሩከ፡ ወእለ፡ ስርግዋን፡ በፍቅርከ፡ ወንሕነሂ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ነሐዩ፡(በእንቲአከ)።
verses.translation: Blessed are they that saw thee, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.

translations.lxx: Blessed are they that saw thee, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.
translations.ron: Fericiţi cei care au văzut şi cei care întru dragoste au adormit, dar şi noi vom fi vii.
translations.grk: Μακάριοι οἱ ἰδόντες σε, καὶ οἱ ἐν ἀγαπήσει κεκοσμημένοι· καὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς ζωῇ ζησόμεθα.

verses.geez: ኤልያስ፡ ዘዐርገ፡ በነደ፡ እሳት፡ ወኤልሳዕኒ፡ ዘመልአ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ እምነ፡ መንፈሱ፡(ቅዱስ)፡ወበመዋዕሊሁኒ፡ ኢያደንግጽዎ፡ መላእክት፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተዐገሎ፡ ወኢመኑሂ።
verses.translation: Elias it was, who was covered with a whirlwind; and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: whilst he lived, he was not moved with the presence of any prince, neither could any bring him into subjection.

translations.lxx: Elias it was, who was covered with a whirlwind; and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: whilst he lived, he was not moved with the presence of any prince, neither could any bring him into subjection.
translations.ron: Când Ilie a fost răpit la cer, în vijelie, Elisei s-a umplut de duhul lui.
translations.grk: Ἠλίας, ὃς ἐν λαίλαπι ἐσκεπάσθη· καὶ Ἐλισαιὲ ἐνεπλήσθη πνεύματος αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐσαλεύθη ὑπὸ ἄρχοντος, καὶ οὐ κατεδυνάστευσεν αὐτὸν οὐδείς.

verses.geez: ወእምኵሉ፡ ነገር፡ አልቦ፡ ዘተስእኖ፡ ወመዊቶሂ፡ ተነበየ፡ በድኑ።
verses.translation: No word could overcome him; and after his death his body prophesied.

translations.lxx: No word could overcome him; and after his death his body prophesied.
translations.ron: în zilele sale nu s-a temut de biruitori şi nimeni nu l-a supus.
translations.grk: Πᾶς λόγος οὐχ ὑπερῇρεν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἐν κοιμήσει ἐπροφήτευσε τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወበሕይወቱሂ፡ ገብረ፡ ነኪረ፡ ወመሞቱሂ፡ ዕጹብ፡ ግብሩ።
verses.translation: He did wonders in his life, and at his death were his works marvellous.

translations.lxx: He did wonders in his life, and at his death were his works marvellous.
translations.ron: Tot cuvântul n-a fost ascuns înaintea lui şi întru adormire a proorocit trupul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν ζωῇ αὐτοῦ ἐποίησε τέρατα. καὶ ἐν τελευτῇ θαυμάσια τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወምስለዝ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኢነስሑ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወኢኀደጉ፡ ጌጋዮሙ፡ እስከ፡ ተፄወዉ፡ እምነ፡ ብሔሮሙ፡ ወተዘርዉ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወተርፉ፡ ኅዳጣን፡ እምውስተ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወመልአ[ክ]፡ እምነ፡ ቤተ፡ ዳዊት።
verses.translation: For all this the people repented not, neither departed they from their sins, till they were spoiled and carried out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth: yet there remained a small people, and a ruler in the house of David:

translations.lxx: For all this the people repented not, neither departed they from their sins, till they were spoiled and carried out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth: yet there remained a small people, and a ruler in the house of David:
translations.ron: Şi în viaţa sa a făcut semne şi la moarte minunate au fost lucrurile lui.
translations.grk: Ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις οὐ μετενόησεν ὁ λαὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν, ἕως ἐπρονομεύθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐσκορπίσθησαν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ· καὶ κατελείφθη ὁ λαὸς ὀλιγοστὸς, καὶ ἄρχων τῷ οἴκῳ Δαυίδ.

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ እለ፡ ገብሩ፡ ሠናየ፡ ወቦ፡ እለ፡ አብዝኅዋ፡ ለኃጢአት።
verses.translation: of whom some did that which was pleasing to God, and some multiplied sins.

translations.lxx: of whom some did that which was pleasing to God, and some multiplied sins.
translations.ron: Cu toate acestea nu s-a pocăit poporul şi n-a încetat de la păcate, până ce a fost scos din ţara sa şi s-a risipit în tot pământul.
translations.grk: Τινὲς μὲν αὐτῶν ἐποίησαν τὸ ἀρεστὸν, τινὲς δὲ ἐπλήθυναν ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: ወሕዝቅያስኒ፡ አጽንዐ፡ ሀገሮ፡ ወአብአ፡ ማየ፡ ማእከላ፡ ወአውቀረ፡ ኰኵሐ፡ በኀጺን፡ ወሐነጸ፡ ምዕቃለ፡ ማይ።
verses.translation: Ezekias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof: he digged the hard rock with iron, and made wells for waters.

translations.lxx: Ezekias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof: he digged the hard rock with iron, and made wells for waters.
translations.ron: Şi a rămas popor puţin şi domn din casa lui David.
translations.grk: Ἐζεκίας ὠχύρωσε τὴν πόλιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἰσήγαγεν εἰς μέσον αὐτῶν τὸν Γώγ· ὤρυξε σιδήρῳ ἀκρότομον, καὶ ᾠκοδόμησε κρήνας εἰς ὕδατα.

verses.geez: ወዐርገ፡ ስናክሬም፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ወለአኮ፡ ለረፍስቂስ፡ ወሖረ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወአንስአ፡ እዴሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽዮን፡ ወተዘኀረ፡ ወአዕበየ፡ አፉሁ።
verses.translation: In his time Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against Sion, and boasted proudly.

translations.lxx: In his time Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against Sion, and boasted proudly.
translations.ron: Unii dintre ei au făcut ce este plăcut; iar unii au înmulţit păcatele.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἀνέβη Σενναχηρὶμ, καὶ ἀπέστειλε Ῥαψάκην, καὶ ἀπῇρε· καὶ ἐπῇρεν ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Σιὼν, καὶ ἐμεγαλαύχησεν ὑπερηφανίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ደንገጾሙ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ወእደዊሆሙ፡ ወሐሙ፡ ከመ፡ እንተ፡ ትውልድ።
verses.translation: Then trembled their hearts and hands, and they were in pain, as women in travail.

translations.lxx: Then trembled their hearts and hands, and they were in pain, as women in travail.
translations.ron: Iezechia a întărit cetatea sa şi a adus în mijlocul ei apă.
translations.grk: Τότε ἐσαλεύθησαν καρδίαι καὶ χεῖρες αὐτῶν, καὶ ὠδίνησαν ὡς αἱ τίκτουσαι.

verses.geez: ወጸውዕዎ፡ ለአእግዚአብሔር፡ ለመሓሪ፡ ወአንሥኡ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወፍጡነ፡ ሰምዖሙ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እምሰማይ፡ ወቤዘዎሙ፡ በእደዊሁ፡ ለ[ኢሳይያስ]።
verses.translation: But they called upon the Lord who is merciful, and stretched out their hands toward him: and immediately the Holy One heard them out of heaven, and delivered them by the ministry of Esay.

translations.lxx: But they called upon the Lord who is merciful, and stretched out their hands toward him: and immediately the Holy One heard them out of heaven, and delivered them by the ministry of Esay.
translations.ron: A săpat cu fier piatra cea colţurată şi a zidit izvoare de apă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπεκαλέσαντο τὸν Κύριον τὸν ἐλεήμονα, ἐκπετάσαντες τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν πρὸς αὐτόν· καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ταχὺ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ Ἡσαΐου.

verses.geez: ወቀተሎሙ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ፡ ለፋርስ፡ ወቀጥቀጦሙ፡ መልአኩ።
verses.translation: He smote the host of the Assyrians, and his angel destroyed them.

translations.lxx: He smote the host of the Assyrians, and his angel destroyed them.
translations.ron: În zilele lui s-a suit Sanherib şi a trimis pe Rabşache şi a ridicat mâna sa asupra Sionului şi s-a semeţit cu trufia sa,
translations.grk: Ἐπάταξε τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν Ἀσσυρίων, καὶ ἐξέτριψεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ገብረ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ ዘይኤድሞ፡ ለእግዘአብሔር፡ ወአጽንዐ፡ [እኂዘ፡]ፍናዌ፡ ዳዊት፡ አቡሁ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዘ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ ነቢይ፡ ወምእመን፡ ውእቱ፡ ወዐቢይ፡ ራእዩ።
verses.translation: For Ezekias had done the thing that pleased the Lord, and was strong in the ways of David his father, as Esay the prophet, who was great and faithful in his vision, had commanded him.

translations.lxx: For Ezekias had done the thing that pleased the Lord, and was strong in the ways of David his father, as Esay the prophet, who was great and faithful in his vision, had commanded him.
translations.ron: Atunci au tremurat inimile şi mâinile lor şi s-au chinuit, ca acele care nasc şi au chemat pe Domnul cel Milostiv, întinzând mâinile lor către El.
translations.grk: Ἐποίησε γὰρ Ἐζεκίας τὸ ἀρεστὸν Κυρίῳ, καὶ ἐνίσχυσεν ἐν ὁδοῖς Δαυὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, ἃς ἐνετείλατο Ἡσαΐας ὁ προφήτης ὁ μέγας, καὶ πιστὸς ἐν ὁράσει αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወተፀርዐት፡ ፀሓይ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ወወሰኮ፡ ዓመቲሁ፡ ለንጉሥ።
verses.translation: In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king's life.

translations.lxx: In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king's life.
translations.ron: Şi Cel Sfânt din cer degrabă i-a auzit şi i-a izbăvit prin mâna lui Isaia.
translations.grk: Ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἀνεπόδισεν ὁ ἥλιος, καὶ προσέθηκε ζωὴν βασιλεῖ·

verses.geez: ወበዐቢይ፡ መንፈስ፡ ርእየ፡ ደኃሪተ፡ ወአስተፍሥሖሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይላሕዉ፡ በጽዮን።
verses.translation: He saw by an excellent spirit what should come to pass at the last, and he comforted them that mourned in Sion.

translations.lxx: He saw by an excellent spirit what should come to pass at the last, and he comforted them that mourned in Sion.
translations.ron: A lovit tabăra Asirienilor ţi i-a omorât pe ei îngerul Lui,
translations.grk: Πνεύματι μεγάλῳ εἶδε τὰ ἔσχατα, καὶ παρεκάλεσε τοὺς πενθοῦντας ἐν Σιών.

verses.geez: ወነገረ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ለዓለም፡ ወዘኒ፡ ኅቡእ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይኩን።
verses.translation: He shewed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things or ever they came.

translations.lxx: He shewed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things or ever they came.
translations.ron: Pentru că Iezechia a făcut ce era plăcut Domnului şi s-a întărit în căile lui David, tatăl său, pe care le-a poruncit în vedenia sa Isaia proorocul cel mare şi credincios.
translations.grk: Ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ὑπέδειξε τὰ ἐσόμενα, καὶ τὰ ἀπόκρυφα πρινὴ παραγενέσθαι αὐτά.
